title: Morgan State University (MorganState)

sections.heading: What MorganState is known for
paragraphs: Morgan State University (MorganState) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and significant undergraduate enrollment of 9,019 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 82.23%, reflecting its inclusive approach to higher education. MorganState is particularly recognized for its strong business programs, which constitute nearly 20% of its academic offerings. Additionally, health-related programs represent about 4.4% of the university's curriculum, highlighting its commitment to preparing students for careers in the healthcare sector. As a public university, MorganState plays an important role in providing accessible education to a broad student population.

paragraphs: Morgan State University provides distinct tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with fees, housing, meals, books, and other personal expenses, amounts to $25,413.
